title: Fleet Unit Incentive Amounts by Unit Price Class
content:
**Fleet program bulletin, Vehicle Purchase Agreements, Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement**

The per-unit amount of the manufacturer fleet unit incentive follows the unit's price class. The class is read from the vehicle price charged on the deal, which is the amount posted on the deal as the vehicle price charge.

| Vehicle price charged on the deal | Per-unit amount |
|---|---|
| At least USD 60000.00 | USD 2150.00 |
| At least USD 45000.00 and below USD 60000.00 | USD 1650.00 |
| Below USD 45000.00 | No price-class amount; the deal type's fleet incentive per unit applies |

## Clause

- A unit whose vehicle price charged is at least 60000.00 earns 2150.00.
- A unit whose vehicle price charged is at least 45000.00 and below 60000.00 earns 1650.00.
- Every other unit earns the deal type's fleet incentive per unit.

## Edge cases (hypothetical prices)

| Vehicle price charged | Class | Per-unit amount |
|---|---|---|
| 60000.00 | upper | 2150.00 |
| 59999.99 | middle | 1650.00 |
| 45000.00 | middle | 1650.00 |
| 44999.99 | neither | deal type's fleet incentive per unit |

The price tested is the vehicle price charge alone. Documentary, filing, title, tax and delivery charges posted on the same deal do not count toward it.
